test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of these is NOT a flow concept?

options.text: Number of machines used in a factory

solution:
The correct answer is __**Number of machines used in a factory.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Flow concept** refers to a** variable **that is measured over a period of time, such as** revenue, expenses, production, or consumption**.
 
• **Profit of a corporation** and **output produced** by a firm are flow concepts because they are measured over a **specific period**, such as **a year, a quarter,** or a month.
 
• **Interest expense** on a loan is also a flow concept because it represents the **amount of money** paid or accrued over time to borrow money.
 
• **Number of machines** used in a factory is** NOT** a flow concept because it is a **stock concept** that represents the quantity of a resource at a specific point in time, rather than the rate of change or flow of that resource.
 
• Other examples of stock concepts include **inventory, capital, assets, liabilities, and equity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Any quantity that can be measured **over time** is referred to as **flow**, whereas **stock** refers to any quantity that can only be measured at a **specific moment** in time.
 
• The flow and the stock are** mutually dependent**.
 
• Stock affects flow because **more capital** will result in a** higher flow** of services.
 
• Flow affects stock; for example, an economy's** increased money supply** leads to an** increase** in the total amount of **money**.
